question: Should iMessage and WhatsApp be newly treated as known native approval-prompt channels, or should prompt discovery retain a narrower capability than native same-turn approval resolution?
rationale: The previous literals intentionally differed, and this PR collapses them into one public manifest field; source context provided for the PR does not establish that the expanded prompt behavior is safe for execution approvals.

options.title: Split the manifest capabilities
options.body: Keep a separate closed prompt-UI flag and mark only channels that previously supported native approval prompts.

options.title: Approve the expanded behavior
options.body: Treat iMessage and WhatsApp as native approval-prompt channels only after maintainers confirm their runtime UI and same-turn approval behavior are supported.

recommendation.title: Split the manifest capabilities
recommendation.body: Keep a separate closed prompt-UI flag and mark only channels that previously supported native approval prompts.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR author introduced the manifest model and is best positioned to clarify whether the previous set difference was intentional; current-main ownership history could not be inspected.
